pages.title: Bunny Holding a Strawberry Coloring Page
pages.description: A bunny hugs a strawberry nearly as wide as its belly in this printable coloring page, with both front paws wrapped around the fruit. The leafy cap sits just below its nose, and rows of tiny seeds fill the space between its paws.

pages.title: Kawaii Boba Tea Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling cup of boba tea fills this printable coloring page, with a wide straw poking through the domed lid and round tapioca pearls settled near the base. The straw is visible through the drink, crossing a wavy liquid line above the pearls.

pages.title: Teddy Bear Holding a Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated teddy bear holds a big heart against its chest in this printable coloring page, with rounded paws curled over the edges. Its feet point forward on either side of the heart, showing one large pad and three small toe pads on each sole.

pages.title: Frog on a Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: A spotted frog perches on a mushroom in this printable coloring page, spreading its round toe pads across the cap. The spots continue across the mushroom in much larger ovals, while curved gills peek out underneath and grass grows around the thick stem.

pages.title: Sleepy Crescent Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: A sleepy crescent moon smiles among three stars in this printable coloring page. The inward curve of the crescent forms a little nose above the smile. A star nestles between the two points, while the other two sit above and below the moon.

pages.title: Cute Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated cat tilts its head in this printable coloring page, with a tuft of fur on its chest and its tail curled across its front paws. A wavy patch marks one haunch, and a second marking runs down the forehead toward the nose.

pages.title: Strawberry Cow Coloring Page
pages.description: A calf with strawberry-shaped markings stands beside a large strawberry in this printable coloring page. Little seeds and leafy tops distinguish the patches on its forehead, flank, and legs. Its four hooves, tufted tail, and small curved horns complete the standing pose.

pages.title: Kawaii Sushi Coloring Page
pages.description: Two smiling pieces of kawaii sushi share this printable coloring page. A piece of nigiri peeks over the top of a maki roll, resting its little hands on the rim. The roll has a cucumber slice with a ring of seeds at its center, and a broad band wraps around the nigiri.

pages.title: Cute Axolotl Coloring Page
pages.description: An axolotl swims past two bubbles in this printable coloring page, with three feathery gills fanning out on each side of its head. Its four small feet point downward and its long finned tail bends back beneath a row of spots.

pages.title: Rainbow with Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: A rainbow stretches between two smiling clouds in this printable coloring page, with a separate raindrop hanging beneath each end. The curved bands meet the scalloped tops of the clouds, leaving long open strips to color above the little faces.

pages.title: Corgi Puppy Coloring Page
pages.description: A corgi puppy lowers its chest and stretches its front paws forward in this printable coloring page. Its upright ears, short legs, and raised hindquarters make the play bow easy to recognize. A wavy marking runs across its back toward the short tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Ice Cream Cone Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling scoop of ice cream sits on a waffle cone in this printable coloring page, topped with sprinkles and a striped wafer stick. One drip hangs over the rim, and the diagonal lines of the cone form a grid of diamond shapes.

pages.title: Cute Red Panda Coloring Page
pages.description: A red panda sits with its bushy tail curled in front of its paws in this printable coloring page. Broad rings divide the tail into coloring spaces. The rounded ears, curved markings along the cheeks, and jagged chest fur distinguish the little animal.

pages.title: Caticorn Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated caticorn has a spiral unicorn horn between its pointed ears in this printable coloring page. A lock of mane falls across the forehead, while a fluffy tail curls up beside the paws. Three small sparkles frame the whiskered face.

pages.title: Baby Chick Hatching Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby chick spreads both wings above the jagged rim of its eggshell in this printable coloring page. The chick has an open beak and a small crest of feathers. A broken piece of shell rests beside the rounded lower half.

pages.title: Cute Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling cupcake has a tall swirl of frosting and a single cherry on top in this printable coloring page. The cherry has a curved stem and one leaf. Straight folds on the wrapper run up to its scalloped rim beneath the frosting.

pages.title: Hedgehog with a Flower Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated hedgehog holds a flower between its front paws in this printable coloring page, tilting its nose toward the rounded petals. A single leaf branches off the stem, and the spiky outline of the hedgehog’s back curves around its two outstretched feet.

pages.title: Baby Sea Turtle Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby sea turtle swims upward among bubbles in this printable coloring page, stretching its long front flippers away from its patterned shell. Smaller flippers trail underneath. Large shell panels and oval markings on the flippers make two distinct patterns to color.

pages.title: Kawaii Cactus Coloring Page
pages.description: A flowering kawaii cactus lifts two curved arms above a smiling pot in this printable coloring page. Tiny sprout-like spines break up the tall ribs, and one flower sits at the crown. The thick rim separates the two cheerful faces.

pages.title: Cute Penguin Coloring Page
pages.description: A little penguin lifts one webbed foot in this printable coloring page, spreading its flippers beside a large oval belly. A tuft of feathers curls above its forehead. The outline around the cheeks and beak gives the face its own coloring space.

pages.title: Kawaii Donut Coloring Page
pages.description: A sprinkled donut holds both arms out and stands on two little feet in this printable coloring page. The central hole shows the inner edge of the ring. A wavy line separates the frosting from the dough beneath the smiling face.

pages.title: Cute Hamster Coloring Page
pages.description: A round-cheeked hamster holds a striped seed between its front paws in this printable coloring page. Two little feet peek out beneath the seated body. Whiskers cross the broad cheeks, and the narrow stripes follow the curve of the seed up to its tip.

pages.title: Mermaid Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: A mermaid cat rests its front paws on a rock in this printable coloring page, with two bubbles floating beside its whiskers. Its body curves into a single fish tail covered with overlapping scales and ending in two broad, leaf-shaped fins.

pages.title: Cute Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: A spotted mushroom has a smiling face, tiny hands, and rounded feet in this printable coloring page. The broad cap overhangs the little figure, revealing a row of gills on its underside. A single curl of grass rises beside one foot.

pages.title: Baby Panda Eating Bamboo Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby panda holds a bamboo stalk with both paws and nibbles a leaf in this printable coloring page. The jointed stem crosses its belly between two forward-facing feet. Outlined face patches and separate paw pads leave room to choose the panda’s markings.

pages.title: Kawaii Strawberry Milk Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling strawberry milk carton spreads its arms in this printable coloring page, with a strawberry emblem on the front and two berries beside its shoes. The folded top gives the carton a boxy shape above the wavy lines of its label.

pages.title: Cute Octopus Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling octopus spreads eight rounded arms beneath its spotted head in this printable coloring page. Four arms curve to each side, with a small outlined suction cup near every tip. The open spaces between the arms make each one easy to follow.

pages.title: Cute Bumblebee Coloring Page
pages.description: A striped bumblebee hovers beside a flower in this printable coloring page, with two antennae pointing forward and overlapping wings lifted above its back. Three jointed legs show along the near side. The rounded flower petals echo the shape of the bee’s wings.

pages.title: Kawaii Avocado Coloring Page
pages.description: A halved avocado has a smiling face on its round pit in this printable coloring page. Two curved borders follow the pear-shaped fruit from the wide base to the narrow stem. A single veined leaf tilts outward from the top.

pages.title: Otters Holding Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Two otters float side by side and touch front paws in this printable coloring page, with their whiskered faces turned toward each other. Their hind feet point up, their long tails curve inward, and small ripples show the water around them.

pages.title: Cute Butterfly Coloring Page
pages.description: A butterfly spreads four patterned wings in this printable coloring page, with a heart on each upper wing and an oval near each lower tip. Two curled antennae rise above its face, and short curved lines divide the body into segments.

pages.title: Kawaii Ramen Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling bowl of ramen holds noodles, half an egg, and a spiral fish cake in this printable coloring page. Two chopsticks lie across the top of the bowl. Little outstretched arms and a pair of feet turn the bowl into a kawaii character.

pages.title: Baby Elephant Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby elephant lifts its curled trunk in this printable coloring page, standing on four broad feet with rounded toenails. Its large ears fan out behind the head, and a short tail with a pointed tuft curls up beside the hind leg.

pages.title: Happy Cloud Coloring Page
pages.description: A happy cloud floats above three raindrops in this printable coloring page, with round cheeks and a wide open smile. A scalloped outline gives the cloud its puffy shape. The middle drop hangs lower than the two drops on either side.

pages.title: Cute Capybara Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara sits beside a clump of cattails in this printable coloring page, with small ears above its long, blunt muzzle. Its front paws rest together below the chest. The upright reeds and narrow leaves rise almost to its nose.

pages.title: Kawaii Milk and Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A glass of milk waves from behind two chocolate chip cookies in this printable coloring page. The glass has a smiling face below its oval milk line. A bite is missing from the front cookie, leaving a scalloped edge beside the second cookie.

pages.title: Cute Jellyfish Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling jellyfish has a spotted, dome-shaped bell in this printable coloring page, with a double scalloped rim above the trailing tentacles. Two broad, ruffled oral arms hang among the thinner strands, giving the lower half a mix of wide and narrow coloring spaces.

pages.title: Duckling in Rain Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: A duckling stands in a puddle wearing two rain boots in this printable coloring page, holding its wings out on either side. The little legs show above the boot cuffs. Curved splash marks rise from the puddle beside the rounded toes.

pages.title: Cute Monster Coloring Page
pages.description: A furry monster waves one hand in this printable coloring page, with two striped horns above its head and two little fangs in its grin. Rounded feet sit below a large belly patch. Three short marks beside the raised hand emphasize the wave.

pages.title: Cute Daisy Coloring Page
pages.description: A daisy has a smiling round center surrounded by broad petals in this printable coloring page. Short curved lines follow the inner edge of each petal. Two pointed leaves branch from opposite sides of the slender stem, each with a few simple veins.

pages.title: Cute Dinosaur Coloring Page
pages.description: A young triceratops lifts a front foot beside a fern in this printable coloring page. Two brow horns and a smaller nose horn stand out in front of its scalloped frill. A row of spots runs along its back toward the upturned tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Popsicle Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling popsicle has a strawberry and two cherries along its top edge in this printable coloring page. The cherries share a leaf above the scalloped topping. A single stick extends below the rounded bar, which leaves a broad area around the face.

pages.title: Sloth Hanging from a Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: A sloth hangs beneath a leafy branch in this printable coloring page, hooking four sets of curved claws over the wood. Its rounded body sags between the grips and its face turns toward the viewer. Three leaves grow near the tip of the branch.

pages.title: Cute Rubber Duck Coloring Page
pages.description: A rubber duck floats inside a ring of ripples in this printable coloring page, with its bill open and its tail pointing upward. One wing follows the curve of the body, and a small tuft curls above the duck’s forehead.

pages.title: Smiling Sun Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling sun has eight rays around its round face in this printable coloring page. Four straight triangular rays alternate with four curved, flame-shaped ones. The open centers of the rays leave room for different colors around the sun’s cheeks and wide smile.

pages.title: Cute Snail Coloring Page
pages.description: A snail stretches along a leaf in this printable coloring page, raising its head and two long feelers in front of its spiral shell. Curved bands follow the shell around the central coil. The pointed leaf has a long midrib and several branching veins.

pages.title: Kawaii Watermelon Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling wedge of watermelon raises both arms in this printable coloring page, with teardrop-shaped seeds scattered across the fruit. Two curved lines mark the rind along the base. Small feet peek out underneath, each with a pair of short toe lines.

pages.title: Cute Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: A toy robot waves a rounded gripper in this printable coloring page, with a ball-tipped antenna on its head and a panel of shapes on its chest. Circular joints connect its arms and legs, and its wide boots have a band along each sole.

pages.title: Shooting Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling five-point star leaves three curved trails behind it in this printable coloring page. The bands sweep upward to the right, with space inside each for a separate color. Three smaller stars surround the face and its round cheeks.

pages.title: Cute Gumball Machine Coloring Page
pages.description: A round gumball machine has a smiling base in this printable coloring page, with overlapping gumballs visible beneath the domed lid. A two-handled knob sits above the dispensing chute. The circles fill the lower half of the glass globe, leaving a wide open space above them.
